summary: Public registration creates a free membership and links the account email to mailing contacts without auto-subscribing.
detailed_changes: Added a memberships table with free status created on registration and backfilled for existing users.
Account portal shows membership status and points members to newsletter preferences.
Registration links or creates a mailing contact by email without starting a new list or newsletter subscribe.
affected_areas: Public impact: clearer free-member portal without changing consent rules
Internal impact: foundation for paid tiers; no Stripe checkout yet
